description: This source file defines a FastAPI web server implementation for a logo replacement backend service. It includes endpoints for creating jobs, uploading files and images, starting processing in background threads, polling status, downloading results, listing processed files, and deleting jobs. It utilizes various external modules (FastAPI, Pydantic, concurrent.futures), custom service modules (src.services.job_store, src.services.processing), and data schemas (src.models.schemas). The application facilitates REST API communication for managing logo replacement workflows on engineering drawing images.
